propositions: A mixed-provider fallback chain disables prompt caching because provider-specific cache keys do not intersect between candidates.
The capability record for a fallback chain is computed as the conservative intersection over its candidates, collapsing disagreeing prompt_cache_style values to 'none'.
An operator observing zero cache read and write tokens on a chain-backed operation may mistake this for a regression when the same model called alone caches normally.
The accounting section of docs/llm-framework.md must document that chain-backed ops legitimately report 0/0 cache metrics due to capability intersection.
runner_support._intersect_capabilities is the canonical authority for mixed-provider fallback chain behavior and should be referenced in operator-facing documentation.
